rules.question: Which font does a kind of text draw in?
rules.decision: D258, the user's yes to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-22-font-role-single-owner.md: "Approved. Yes to all five recommendations (Q1-Q5)."

exempt.why: loads the two font files and sets the default font; it picks no role
declares the handle the loader fills; the owner is its only reader
measure_in_font is the width primitive; it measures in the font the owner handed it

must_match: return font->CalcTextSizeA(size, FLT_MAX, 0.0f, s.data(), s.data() + s.size()).x;
must_not_match: text_at(ImVec2(top.x + l.measure_x, text_y), text_color(), a.measure.c_str(), TextRole::Figure);
rules.note: A raw font pick is any of: reading the mono handle, pushing a font, asking ImGui for the current font to draw with, or measuring through a font pointer. ImGui::CalcTextSize with no font argument is allowed: it measures in whatever font a ScopedFont pushed, so it agrees with the draw by construction. No anchor: the alternatives share no plain text. Decided by: D258.
